0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-11, 15th in the East) head to Orlando on an eight-game losing streak and are 0-5 on the road, while the Orlando Magic (4-7, 10th in the East) have won two straight but are 0-4 at home. Milwaukee will be without Myles Turner (out, rest) and Ryan Rollins (day-to-day, game-time decision, head), and Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jamal Cain, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero and Tristan da Silva. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost 1-2 in the season series, including a 130-91 loss in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
